get.summary: List the settings a tenant edits, with the value its layer holds and the value a read resolves to; an owner or an admin only

403.description: The caller does not administer the tenant

put.summary: Write a value into the layer of the tenant the request names; an owner or an admin only

200.description: The setting as it now stands

400.description: The body is not a JSON object this route reads

403.description: The caller does not administer the tenant

404.description: No setting a tenant edits has the key

422.description: The value does not convert to the setting's declared type, or the body carries none

delete.summary: Remove the tenant's own value of a setting, which then resolves to the global value or the declared default; an owner or an admin only

200.description: The setting as it now resolves

403.description: The caller does not administer the tenant

404.description: No setting a tenant edits has the key

Tenant.name: X-Tenant
Tenant.description: The alias of the tenant the request is scoped to

PreferenceKey.name: key
PreferenceKey.description: The full path of the setting, such as deals.default-currency

sensitive.description: The value is not shown: written and value read ******** where one is set, and default is null

default.description: The declared default in the declared type's text form; null for a sensitive setting, whose default is withheld

written.description: The text the layer's own row holds, null when it holds none

value.description: The value a read in the layer resolves to; a duration as its text

tenant.description: The tenant whose layer is listed; absent for the global layer

value.description: The value, in the form a configuration source gives it: a duration as text such as "5m", a number for an integer
